open_items.text: Decide whether ledger ids become per-lane namespaced (SAF-NNNN style, collision-free by construction) and the global LL-NNNN space is retired. Detection now catches a collision, so this is no longer urgent - but retiring the global space changes what 30 existing entries, and every roadmap item and branch citing an LL id, refer to. Operator decision

ops/loop/ledger.py self-checks that every byte below the marker survives an append, and that CHECK is still deletable in silence - removing the raise leaves the suite green, because the behavioural tests cover the outcome and nothing forces the assertion path. LL-0042 over-claimed that it was covered. Decide whether a defensive assert with no reachable trigger is worth a test or should simply not claim coverage

A 4-space indented code block whose first token is id-shaped is falsely refused by _assert_headings_parse - indented code is not fenced, so the guard treats it as a broken heading. Loud, not silent, but it is a false positive and a guard that cries wolf gets switched off. Found by the refutation pass on LL-0038

resume_note: ROADMAP 2d closed on lane/ops - the contract names no absolute path, so a fresh clone runs 957 green. OPS-4 closed. OPS-6 (per-lane id namespacing) is still an operator decision, recorded not taken
